methodology: Identity-only universe expand batch 3. Prefer airwindows (Airwindopedia + Consolidated), sugar-bytes, madrona-labs, sonic-charge, neural-dsp, positive-grid, initial-audio, wa-production fills, cymatics, audiorealism, dawesome (dedup tracktion), line-6, kemper, vcv hub, ssl software fills, NI library long-tail, softube residual. No invented versions. Dedup by plugin id + name + normalized name. elysia remains under plugin-alliance; Cardinal already oas--distrho-cardinal; vital/surge already present.
